newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Plastics name change approved.
newsitem.headline: Royal Plastics name change approved.

text.p: Royal Plastics Group Ltd said on Friday its shareholders approved the company's decision to change its name to Royal Group Technologies Ltd, effective today.

Royal said the name change, which better reflected the company's strategic emphasis on introducing technologically advanced products through the world, was approved by Royal's shareholders at their annual meeting on February 12.
Royal will continue to be traded under the RYG symbol on the Toronto, Montreal and New York Stock Exchanges.
